published_record.tested_law_part: Temporary lane barrier and designated direction: measured opposite-direction travel in the cone-separated closed lane, followed by a stop before the taper.
not_testable_from_this_video: Actual municipal authority and adoption of the temporary direction period are explicit synthetic premises.
The physical barrier is measured; its closed-lane regulatory meaning and designated direction are explicit assumptions, not OCR or a literal sign face.
Transitions between different periods, conflicting traffic and other temporary control devices are not tested.
Opposing cases stop before the diagonal taper; cone collisions are not required or tested.
Continuous-time behavior between 20 Hz samples is unobserved.
